component.name: Zyclipa
component.summary: Instant replay, recording, clip editing and a soundboard

description.p: Zyclipa keeps the last moments of your game ready to save as a clip, records your screen, and edits and exports clips (including under 10 MB for Discord). It has a soundboard with up to 300% volume and a phone dashboard.
On Linux, recording uses X11 screen capture and PulseAudio/PipeWire sound. Per-app volume mixing and global shortcuts are Windows-only for now.
